checks.message: required fields and manuscript-derived text agree
PDF and build inputs match recorded hashes
13 cited IDs resolve to 13 entries; factual support is checked in claims.yaml

A conditional possibility, not an observed population effect. The finite-set identity and branching construction establish persistence under fixed pursuit parameters; the prospective study is needed to test the explanation in people.
Defines the evidential genre. No participants, fitted model, simulations or original behavioral observations are claimed.
A task-relative operational definition. Excludes willingness from opportunity membership and distinguishes investigable questions from intelligible but presently inaccessible questions.
Holds physical task resources fixed for the conceptual comparison. The account does not equate a learned new use with an exogenous change in equipment.

For finite fixed Q_t, N_t is the sum of indicator variables for questions in that starting set. Conditional linearity of expectation gives E[N_t]=sum pi_t(q), even with correlated pursuit decisions. Newly generated questions inside the window are outside this snapshot count.

Subtract the old finite sum from the new one. Retained terms cancel; additional probabilities are nonnegative, at least one strictly positive. Resource competition can violate the fixed-old-probability premise.
With a fixed time budget, added candidates can displace existing choices. This is a possibility, not a measured effect.
Read primary Europe PMC full-text XML. Search and self-report dissociate; the manuscript retains the high-confidence exception and imperfect introspective access.
Read the author-hosted published paper's abstract and introduction. Some traits predict task information demand; several central curiosity constructs do not. No cross-task unit of desire is inferred.
Prevents inflating opportunity counts by paraphrases or alternative procedures for the same unresolved contrast. Coding remains task-relative and requires reliability checks.
Restricts the construct to accessible candidates. Elicitation cannot by itself distinguish new composition from retrieval or changes in salience.

Entropy is defined over specified variables/distributions. Adding a represented variable changes the object whose uncertainty is measured. No claim that conditioning increases entropy for a fixed variable is made.

Idealized independent branching with finite conditional offspring mean k, resolution probability s and pursuit probability p. Convergence, unresolved productive branches, fatigue and finite budgets are expressly excluded and discussed afterward.

Each investigation resolves with probability s, produces conditional expected k novel candidates, and independently retains each with probability p, hence mean offspring skp. Conditional expectation given Z_n is skp Z_n. Iteration yields E[Z_n]=Z_0(skp)^n for fixed Z_0. This is a symbolic derivation, not an empirical or simulated number.
Random offspring can yield termination even when the mean exceeds one. The paper claims neither almost-sure persistence nor indefinite physical growth under finite resources.
Conditional on the branching assumptions and skp>1, expected generation size increases with no change in s or p. Stationary pursuit is not itself a measurement of constant human motivation.
Read OCR of the scanned author-hosted PDF pages. The original account permits shifting informational reference points; the manuscript explicitly treats it as a predecessor.
Read primary author-hosted manuscript. Model improvement supplies reward to a separate action-selecting controller; passive compression is not claimed to create motivation.
Read author-hosted published text. Intelligent Adaptive Curiosity selects situations by learning progress; reported developmental sequences concern the studied robots.
Read primary Europe PMC XML. Their model comparisons support learning-progress plus competence sensitivity in free task selection, not unique identification of all human inquiry mechanisms.
Consulted 2023 publisher full text after the 2022 preprint lead. Growth and flexibility are explicit predecessors; the manuscript makes no priority claim over them.
Read published full-text XML, not only the 2024 conference lead. The neighboring manuscript sentence retains the weaker grammar-based recombination result.
Primary text reports no statistically significant recombination effect using grammar-based similarity, with more supportive semantic evidence. No null-is-equivalent inference is made.
Read primary manuscript. It presents a rational computational-level account; the manuscript treats usefulness as a serious alternative, not a strawman.
Read primary published PDF. The association and authors' reinforcement interpretation are distinguished; semantic relatedness limits generalization.

Participants rate whether an answer was worth waiting for after viewing it; satisfaction/expectation measures enter later analyses. Randomized question order and wait costs do not randomize satisfaction itself.
Generating a list can itself activate candidates before free exploration. A parallel condition tests that possible measurement effect; it is not asserted as an observed effect in this task.

Prospective conditional prediction. Shared comprehended candidates reduce a generation bottleneck; the adjacent paragraph states that menus also affect salience, effort, teaching and social expectations.
The common menu can change several variables at once. An interaction is compatible with candidate generation but does not uniquely isolate it.

Explicit causal scenario: treatment and prior ability both influence a competence threshold; conditioning on threshold selection can associate treatment with prior ability, which also influences exploration. No claim that this bias must occur in every design.
Failure to reject a zero difference does not bound effects within a meaningful equivalence range. The preceding sentence requires prespecified bounds, precision and measurement sensitivity.
Records that the proposed study is unexecuted and unpreregistered. No numerical estimates or human-participant results are offered.
Read author-hosted conference paper and lab publication identity. Reported comparison is about task exploration under specified action mappings, not motivation arising de novo.
Read reported controls. The manuscript explicitly avoids treating nonsignificance as equivalence or claiming that every architecture is fractal-independent.

Constructive counterexample: a compressor with an externally supplied stream and no action-selection mechanism can improve compression without choosing observations. An active mechanism or disposition is an additional premise.

Read the primary author-hosted published paper and checked publisher bibliographic identity. Evidence concerns signaling information and gradient-climbing performance, not phenomenal or noninstrumental curiosity.
Conceptual distinction between the object of motivation and causes that elicit or modify it. The paper rejects the seed's stronger claim of causal insulation.
Read primary author-hosted published PDF. The claim stays within the toy tasks and pedagogical conditions and does not generalize to schooling as a whole.

Conditional on valuing independent inquiry, teaching should consider candidate availability and cues of completeness as well as answer mastery. This is an argued recommendation, not an experimentally established intervention effect.
Finite resources, reliable procedures and practical completion remain legitimate educational and personal aims. The account distinguishes opportunity from an obligation to pursue every candidate.
